title: plasmashell loses focus too easily in cases where the user probably want to keep it there instead of focusing thewindow at the top of the window stack
line: Closing the Application Launcher with the pointer on the panel no longer makes the panel vanish when a fullscreen app is open.
explanation: When a panel popup such as Kickoff closes, KWin gives focus back to the window below it. If that window is fullscreen, becoming active moves it to the active-fullscreen layer above panels, so it covers the panel the pointer is resting on; plasmashell gets a Leave event and an auto-hide panel hides at once, while without a fullscreen window the panel stays. Now, when a fullscreen window becomes active while the pointer is on a panel that was shown above it, KWin keeps that panel stacked above the fullscreen window until the pointer leaves it; focus still goes to the fullscreen app as before.

commits.message:
layershell: keep the panel under the pointer above activated fullscreen

When a fullscreen window became active while the pointer was on a panel,
for example after closing Kickoff, it covered the panel at once and hid
an auto-hide one; now the panel stays above until the pointer leaves it.

BUG: 519796

media.caption: Fullscreen Konsole, auto-hide panel: Meta opens Kickoff, clicking the launcher icon closes it and the panel disappears with the pointer still on it.
Same setup: closing Kickoff by its icon, then with Escape; each time the panel stays under the pointer, typing goes to Konsole, and the panel hides once the pointer moves away.
1 s after closing Kickoff by its icon: panel gone, pointer still on the launcher.
1 s after closing Kickoff by its icon: panel still shown above the fullscreen Konsole.
1 s after closing Kickoff with Escape, pointer on the launcher: panel gone.
1 s after closing Kickoff with Escape, pointer on the launcher: panel still shown.
